Registry and counting notes These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Results and verificationMethods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Flat frictionless bed on[-10,10]m, dam0, hL=1m/hR=0, initial velocity0, g=9.81, t=.5s,1600/3200/6400 cells. The Ritter formula uses an explicit rescaling distinct from the paper numerical example. Editorial clarification The .001m mean-depth contour differs from the analytic support edge, which is reported separately. These fixed runs test wetting of initially dry cells. Retreating shorelines, re-drying cycles, real floods, friction and moving fronts over topography are outside scope. The initial100/200/400-cell [-5,5]m attempt passed28 tests and105/109 gates; three retained-dry-cell gates and the .3960m>.25m contour error failed. All original records remain archived; revision2 enlarges/refines the input without changing acceptance. Revision2 then stopped on a binary64 subnormal-tail dry-momentum artifact. Revision3 factors the same HLL update into water packets and adds three regression/equivalence tests; the original28 remain unchanged. Revision3 passed108/109 gates but failed the .27415m>.25m contour criterion. Revision4 refines only Ritter grids to1600/3200/6400. Relative depth L1 is normalized by domain reference mass; absolute L1 is also retained because the domain changed between revisions1 and2. Final revision4 uses1600/3200/6400cells on[-10,10]m at t.5s and passed31 unit checks and all109 group gates. Acceptance depthL1 retains the original fixed reference mass5m², giving finest.001773819 and absolute depthL1.008869095m². Normalization by the enlarged-domain reference mass10m² gives.000886909 as a separate diagnostic, never an easier acceptance criterion. Relative momentumL1 is.009590172; the depth.001m contour error is.2069613m<.25m and1679 genuinely dry cells remain. All three earlier failures are retained; depth floors,state clips and retries are zero. Adopted numerical method The FV solver supports h=q=0 directly; one-sided dry HLL speeds use u-c/u+2c and their reflection. Forward Euler at face CFL .4 records every minimum and shared-flux budget without raising cell depths.
